objects.failed_claim: Injective binary exponent weights plus a fixed supplied list of finite-field values or Hasse jets distinguish every nonempty witness set from the empty set.
objects.object: P(T)=Lambda(T); force bits >=ceil(log2(D+1)) to zero; exclude exactly the low-bit codes whose coefficient in P is zero.
objects.exact_observation: Every specified Hasse jet is identically zero.
objects.encoding_cost: O((n+(D+1)log(D+2))log(n+2)) bits; all construction and field arithmetic charged.
objects.scope: Fixed observation list. Does not exclude formula-dependent selection or establish a lower bound for bounded-input-length CNFs. The counterexample's own input length must be charged.

objects.failed_claim: The listed four finite-field values certify existence for every 3-variable CNF.
objects.scope: This specified four-point list; no lower bound for other point choices.

objects.failed_claim: All values in F_(2^d), with all Hasse jets of order below 2^h, always detect nonempty CNF witness sets on d+h+1 variables.
objects.clauses: Pin all bits except x_h,x_(d+h) to zero; add (x_h OR x_(d+h)) AND (NOT x_h OR NOT x_(d+h)).
objects.exact_observation: All specified jets vanish at all field points; order 2^h equals 1.
objects.scope: Entire specified field and stated jet cutoff. The formula family is directly tractable.

objects.failed_claim: For the retained K-H-K^T embedding, a characteristic-two weighted target can be recovered at precision independent of the total weak-wire count merely because the desired output is reduced modulo 2.
objects.exact_observation: For p<=E the embedded residue is zero for every W. At p=E+1 it recovers W mod 2 by coefficientwise division.
objects.mode_count: At p=E+1 and delta_i=1 all 2^E weak-wire subsets meet the valuation cutoff.
objects.scope: This embedding, residue readout, and cutoff-based enumeration only. Does not exclude another scalar evaluator.
